claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The bike may not be a Maybach 27-inch model as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the frame or head tube showing the brand and size label, or a photo of the rear wheel with a size stamp.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 27-inch mountain bike, not as a Maybach.

risks.risk: The disc brakes may not be functional or may be worn.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the brake rotors and calipers, showing condition and wear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having non-functional or worn brakes.

risks.risk: The bike may have hidden damage or defects not visible in the photo.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or incomplete.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the frame or head tube showing the brand and size label.
A close-up photo of the rear wheel with a size stamp.
A close-up photo of the front disc brake rotor and caliper.
A full 360-degree video or multiple photos showing the frame, wheels, and components from all angles.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
